create_optax_wrapper: create an OptaxWrapper to make an optax GradientTransformation compatible with T5X optimizer interface
wrap_optax_optimizer: wrap an optax optimizer constructor to return a T5X-compatible OptimizerDef using wrap_optax_optimizer
create_multi_optimizer: create a MultiOptimizer to apply separate optimizer algorithms to different subsets of model parameters
derive_optax_logical_axes: derive logical partitioning axes for optax optimizer state from model parameter logical axes
restore_optimizer_state: restore an optimizer target and state from a serialized state dict using OptimizerDef restore_state
